$comment: What scripts/smoke.mjs does with a package on Windows and Linux, where the journeys can't run: the app's own test ids (its *Ui objects in packages/contracts). `start` is what a new, empty data folder shows; after `steps`, the app shows `after`, and still does when opened again. Without settings (`python3 scripts/patcher.py init`) nothing can be saved, so this proves the window opens, answers through the bridge and shows the empty stack.
